QuestInfo.name: Result of the Second Mission
QuestInfo.0: Did the Black Wing missions really help people? Or were you just being used? Go to #b#m211000000##k and find out the result of your second mission of collecting and trading Zombie teeth.
QuestInfo.1: #p2020009#, the Chief in #m211000000#, says that there are traces of the basement key being copied, and though she suspects #p2022003#, she has no proof. She says that the #m211000001# basement is highly guarded because there is a very important item inside. It's certain that the key you received from #p2022003# has gone into the hands of the Black Wings. #rWhat you thought was going to help #m211000000# has only helped the Black Wings.#k.
